english_text: in writing . - The idea of a Generalised System of Preferences ( GSP ) goes back to 1968 , when tariffs were much higher in general and when they were still seen as the main barrier to trade from developing to industrialised countries . The first three-year scheme was implemented from 2006 to 2008 . The second scheme is due to expire on 31 December 2011 . The current scheme was adopted in 2008 under the consultation procedure . This should not happen again for the forthcoming regulation , in particular given Parliament 's new competencies under the Treaty of Lisbon .
